display.purpose: The homepage greeting; mobile overrides follow the responsive layout.

date.purpose: The pale blue edition spine with tabular numerals.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The blue action used to prepare a research task.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default;}.ds-primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper);}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover);}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default;}.ds-secondary{background:var(--paper);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--line);}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#eef2f9;border-color:#b6c1d5;}

components.name: Research field
components.description: Topic input, with visible label and the actual form field treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-topic">你想研究什么？</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-topic" placeholder="例如：AI Agent 的记忆系统" />
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:550;margin-bottom:12px;}.ds-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;width:100%;max-width:420px;border:1px solid #d9dfe9;border-radius:7px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink);background:#fcfcfe;caret-color:var(--accent);transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#657080;opacity:1;}.ds-field:hover{border-color:#d9dfe9;}.ds-field:focus{border-color:#8b9dc0;background:#fff;}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Rail navigation
components.description: Current destination uses pale blue in a light neutral shell.
components.html: 每日阅读深度调研
components.css: .ds-rail{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;width:176px;padding:20px;background:var(--sidebar-bg);border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}.ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:47px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;color:#586377;text-decoration:none;transition:background .18s,color .18s;}.ds-nav:hover{background:#edf0f5;color:var(--accent);}.ds-nav.ds-current{background:var(--selection);color:#425b8c;font-weight:650;}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Source filters
components.description: Muted source filters become blue when selected.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}.ds-filter{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s;}.ds-filter:hover:not(.ds-selected){background:var(--accent-soft);}.ds-filter.ds-selected{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper);}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Digest card
components.description: A document entry stays flat and responds through its border.
components.css: .ds-digest{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;display:block;width:100%;max-width:520px;text-align:left;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:23px 24px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-digest:hover{border-color:#a5b2cd;background:#fcfcfe;}.ds-digest:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);}.ds-digest h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.65;margin:14px 0 10px;letter-spacing:-.01em;}.ds-digest p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.95;}

components.name: Calendar dates
components.description: Published dates are actionable; unavailable dates remain disabled.
components.html: 2026年11月
components.css: .ds-calendar{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;max-width:252px;background:#f0f2f6;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:17px;color:var(--ink);}.ds-calendar strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;}.ds-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px;margin-top:13px;}.ds-day{border:0;background:transparent;min-height:29px;padding:5px 0;font-size:12px;border-radius:6px;color:#5b6981;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s;}.ds-day:disabled{color:#6f7a8b;cursor:default;}.ds-available{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;background:#e0e7f5;}.ds-available:hover,.ds-today{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;}.ds-day:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Research report
components.description: Research uses the same paper silhouette with a warm cover strip.
components.css: .ds-report{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0;text-align:left;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;max-width:340px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .18s;}.ds-report:hover{border-color:#a5b2cd;}.ds-report:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #647eac);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-cover{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;color:#79613e;background:#f2ecdf;padding:18px 22px;font-size:12px;}.ds-report-info{padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}.ds-report-info small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);}.ds-report-info strong{font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;margin:14px 0 10px;color:var(--ink);}.ds-report-info>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85;}

narrative.overview:
知更 is a personal AI reading space shaped by contemporary public-library wayfinding. Light neutral navigation gives the collection a stable address; grey-white reading fields, pale blue date markers and restrained blue selection make it easy to move from daily discovery into sourced research.

The interface is calm, practical and information-rich. Chinese system sans typography, compact metadata and clear document surfaces support both a short daily visit and a longer reading session. The bird wordmark is a lightweight SVG symbol; the identity does not depend on photographic or raster decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent light neutral navigation and grey-white reading surfaces.
A date spine connects the latest edition to the availability calendar.
Daily reading and deep research share the same document vocabulary.
Color and explicit labels communicate source and generation states.

rules.name: Reading Field
rules.body: Keep article text and navigation on light surfaces; use restrained blue for actions and selection.

rules.name: Quiet Depth
rules.body: Use borders and tonal fields for resting content; reserve shadows for overlays.

dos: Do use low-saturation blue for primary actions and a pale blue field for the active navigation item.
Do keep date availability, source failures and generation modes explicit.
Do preserve a visible keyboard focus treatment and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep reader prose at its implemented comfortable measure and allow long links and tables to wrap or scroll.
donts: Don't use a dark forest navigation shell; keep navigation in the light neutral surface system.
Don't add resting card shadows where borders and tonal fields already establish grouping.
Don't turn unavailable calendar dates into actionable controls.
Don't replace real content or collection status with invented activity.
